title: Archive and Orbit Again
author: Wren Vasquez
blurb: Coral Quintana, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
